provenance_reconciliation.sole_change: Import asdict from dataclasses for recorded BoatState serialization under if trace.
provenance_reconciliation.scope: Branches disable trace. Applied-motion reports require the corrected import. The decision and plant logic are byte-identical and all original receipts remain pinned.

sailing_time_comparison: Method minus baseline, computed only on routes finished by both arms.
timing_scope: Native control decision and safety screening wall time, including learned inference. Offline branch generation, model fitting, independent audit and plant advance are excluded.
